gloss: to report; to notify; to file

definitions.gloss: to report; to notify; to file
definitions.explanation: To formally report or notify authorities or an organization about something, such as filing official documents or reporting incidents.

examples.japanese: {転居|てんきょ}を{届|とど}け{出|で}た。
examples.english: I filed a change of address notice.

examples.japanese: {紛失|ふんしつ}を{警察|けいさつ}に{届|とど}け{出|で}た。
examples.english: I reported the loss to the police.

examples.japanese: {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}を{届|とど}け{出|で}る。

notes:
{届|とど}け{出|で}る is used for formal notifications to authorities or organizations.

COMMON OBJECTS:
- {転居届|てんきょとどけ}を{届|とど}け{出|で}る: to file a change of address
- {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}を{届|とど}け{出|で}る: to file a marriage registration
- {紛失届|ふんしつとどけ}を{届|とど}け{出|で}る: to file a loss report
- {退職届|たいしょくとどけ}を{届|とど}け{出|で}る: to submit a resignation

GRAMMAR NOTE:
This is a compound verb combining {届|とど}ける (to deliver) and {出|で}る (to come out/submit).
